expectations.text: Every expected 422 for the weight-band rule names failing_gate AIRCRAFT (not ZONE) with rule_reference `ZC-2026.1 §2`.
expectations.evidence: All 7 expected 422s: AIRCRAFT / `ZC-2026.1 §2`; ZONE never used.

expectations.text: Boundary cases use a band threshold from 06 §3 in grams (900/901, 3500/3501 or 12000/12001), one gram apart.
Preconditions pin PILOT to pass for the chosen zone: the pilot rating covers that zone's class (CONTROLLED needs R_ADVANCED or R_BVLOS, RESTRICTED needs R_BVLOS) and certification is current.
expectations.evidence: RESTRICTED zones use R_BVLOS (13), CONTROLLED KBP-CTR-3 uses R_ADVANCED (7); certification current.

expectations.text: No case expects a self-registered (L1) operator to pass validate/submit in a zone that requires L2 or L3; such cases either state the higher level as pre-existing out-of-band data, or are skipped with a reason.
expectations.evidence: Pass-side cases require an L3/L2 operator 'that has to exist already… signed in via POST /auth/login' (line 12); fail-side uses L1 since AIRCRAFT runs before ZONE.

expectations.text: Every HTTP step names exactly one auth (operator session, X-Reviewer-Id or none); no operator step sends X-Reviewer-Id and no step sends operator_id in the body.
No expected result asserts the exact text of a 422 `message`; at most that it is non-empty.
The cases contain no absolute calendar dates, emails, UUIDs, national IDs or serial numbers; times are stated relative to a threshold or to request time.
expectations.evidence: No dates/emails/UUIDs; catalogue zone codes only where the rule depends on them.

expectations.text: Expected results assert only response fields defined in Confluence 01/03 (e.g. state, failing_gate, rule_reference, message, rejection_reason) and no invented ones such as `ok`.
